name: boss-4
about: Boss Rush: The Fine Print (a scribe with quill-pen arms and a chest of clauses). Tripo H3.1 from concept boss04-fineprint-sd-1; rigged by Tripo (rig v1.0, biped); eight clips retargeted from Tripo's presets (two requests); parts from Tripo segmentation, each bound whole to the bone that owns it, so the armour stays rigid on a motion-captured skeleton.
